global_organization_chain: Summary chain: system abstraction -> seal case -> split forecast -> fitted-period check -> AHP evaluation -> recovery feedback -> expedition report.
Introduction chain: useful plastic properties -> the same properties create harm -> source/accumulation background -> two explicit questions.
Problem-analysis chain: debris input -> ocean system -> impacts output -> good-state criterion -> reduce input -> split debris and impacts.
Sequence chain: observed counts -> visible growth with fluctuation -> certain component plus smooth random component.
GM chain: original sequence -> accumulated sequence -> differential equation -> least-squares parameters -> growth forecast.
Residual chain: subtract growth -> inspect ACF/PACF -> choose AR(2) -> forecast random motion -> recombine.
Validation chain: compare fitted period -> report 0.9767 -> However reveal post-2000 deviation -> connect timing to recovery -> restrict old-regime interpretation.
Implication chain: baseline entanglement growth -> endangered population -> extinction claim -> food-chain claim -> broader ecosystem warning.
AHP chain: divide layers -> compare criteria -> calculate weights -> define symbols -> aggregate metrics.
Evaluation chain: normalize values -> refuse direct add/multiply -> form EV -> define lower-both direction -> construct f(EV).
Figure chain: read debris/predictive/actual trajectories -> contrast score growth -> identify post-2000 improvement relative to baseline.
Feedback chain: worsening state -> two drivers -> decrease debris -> increase recovery -> redraw negative feedback.
Boundary chain: list prediction strength -> acknowledge AHP subjectivity -> retain vector convenience.
Manager chain: repeat ecosystem and system findings -> name two action directions -> list feasible solutions -> explain nonbinding gap -> assign government policy.
References, running furniture, chart labels, symbol-table cells, and formula-only blocks are excluded; final G7 warnings follow positive G1-G6 evidence.
